summary.en: Electric blues, backbeat, and teen radio invent the rock band format.
summary.zh: 电蓝调、后拍与青少年电台，定下摇滚乐队的基本格式。

sound.en: Twangy single-coil, 2/4 backbeat, AM radio compression, loud small amps
sound.zh: 单线圈拨弦脆响、2/4 后拍、AM 电台压缩、小功率音箱开大

body.en:
Rock starts in jukeboxes and small clubs, not museums. Chicago and Memphis electric blues bend notes with tube amps. Chuck Berry writes verse–chorus guitar songs you can dance to. Elvis brings country–R&B hybrids onto national TV in 1956.

The toolkit is simple: amplified guitar, drums on the backbeat, radio airplay, a teenage market. Later British Invasion, metal, and punk still reuse licks, song lengths, and stage moves from this period.
body.zh:
摇滚起步于点唱机和小俱乐部，不是博物馆。芝加哥与孟菲斯电蓝调用电子管音箱弯音。Chuck Berry 写出能跳舞的主歌–副歌吉他歌。Elvis 在 1956 年把乡村与 R&B 的混血推上全美电视。

工具箱很简单：扩音吉他、后拍鼓点、电台放送、青少年市场。后来的英伦入侵、金属与朋克，仍在复用这一时期的 Lick、歌曲长度与舞台动作。
